name: Draw On Madness
body:
No matter the burden on your psyche, how far your mind has to bend, you will get the upper hand.

Prerequisite(s): Madness focus, mesmerist level 7

Benefit(s): A number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier, you can cast spells of the focus you last used as if they were on your list of spells known.
